note: Subject layer of the faction building samples of bead pulp_wars-xdh.1 (docs/art/FACTION_BUILDINGS.md). Each line names its own materials and colours, because the classes used here skip the faction layer. Exploration only.

subjects.IMPROVEMENT:FARM/GRAVEYARD: Subject: a small old graveyard plot: three straight horizontal strips of dark grey-brown earth, one above the other, each running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with clear empty transparent gaps between the strips; on each strip lies one row of five small low rounded burial mounds of dark earth side by side, each with a small dark weathered wooden cross at its head, and a few tiny pale violet flowers between the mounds; muted dark slate, dusty grey-brown and charcoal colours. Earth, mounds, crosses and flowers only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:FARM/MUSHROOMS: Subject: a small mushroom farm: three straight horizontal strips of dark brown peat soil, one above the other, each running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with clear empty transparent gaps between the strips; on each strip grows one row of five plump round mushrooms side by side, with broad smooth tan and russet-brown caps and short pale cream stalks, and a few small mushrooms between the big ones. Mushrooms and soil only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL/SOLAR: Subject: a solar power collector: three big flat rectangular solar panels of dark navy-blue glass divided into a grid of small square cells by thin silver lines, tilted up toward the sky on slender polished chrome stands, side by side in a row, each on short dark gunmetal feet, with one short chrome mast between them topped by one small hot magenta pink light; wide and low, like a toy. Machine only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL/GRINDSTONE: Subject: a stone-age grinding mill: one huge round flat grey millstone with a hole in its centre resting flat on three squat dark basalt stones, a thick rough wooden pole through its hole as a lever, and a small lean-to shelter of tawny hide stretched over curved pale bone poles behind it, with a woven basket of grain beside the stone; wide and low; no metal anywhere. Buildings only.
subjects.TERRAIN:GRASS/UNDEAD: Subject: a wide flat meadow of short, slightly withered lawn grass seen from directly above, one even calm cool grey-green base colour with small darker grass tufts scattered evenly and sparsely all over, nothing else.
subjects.TERRAIN:GRASS/UNDEAD_LEAVES: Subject: a wide flat meadow of short, slightly withered lawn grass seen from directly above, one even calm cool grey-green base colour with small darker grass tufts and a very few tiny dark dusky-purple fallen leaves scattered evenly and sparsely all over, nothing else.
